turns.text:
real quick can u proofread this text to jade. gotta leave for my 2 section soon so need it done before i go. keep it short

"hey i'm sorry i was out cold again on ur day off. saturday evening pho at phở bến thành like usual? my treat"

Looks good. Only small fixes, mostly capitalization and punctuation:

"Hey, I'm sorry I was out cold again on your day off. Saturday evening at Phở Bến Thành like usual? My treat."

If you'd rather keep your lowercase texting style, it works as is. Want a slightly warmer version, or is this the one?
nah keep it lowercase. she texted me this earlier tho: "it's just kinda lonely when ur asleep the whole time i'm off. wish u were awake more" so idk if sorry + pho is enough

Her message sounds like she wants time with you, not just an apology. You could add a line that shows you're thinking about that, still short and lowercase:

"hey i'm sorry i was out cold again on ur day off. i hear u. saturday evening at phở bến thành like usual? my treat"

If you want to offer something extra, I can add a spot like "and i'll try to be up for a call on ur next day off." Want that in?
call before 1 wont work tho i sleep 8 to 1 after shift. can u help me fix my sleep schedule real quick so i can be up more on her days off. not the 8 hours lecture, i know. ill tweak it myself

No lecture. Here's a rough starting point you can adjust:

- Keep your main sleep after shift, but on her days off, set an alarm for a shorter block, like 8 to 11:30.
- Take a 60 to 90 minute nap later in the afternoon so you don't crash in the evening.
- Save the call or hangout for that stretch after you're up.

Tweak the times however fits your week. For the text, here's a version that doesn't promise a call before 1:

"hey i'm sorry i was out cold again on ur day off. i hear u. saturday evening at phở bến thành like usual? my treat. and i'll try to be up earlier for ur next one"
lol ok that helped. sending it. thx
Nice, good luck in your section. Hope the evening goes well!
